topics.question: What does principal-component analysis preserve when it reduces a dataset to fewer dimensions?
topics.coverage: Follow centered synthetic features, variance directions, projection and reconstruction loss; distinguish a visually separated projection from validated classes or causal factors.

topics.question: How can active learning choose which examples a person should label next?
topics.coverage: Compare uncertainty sampling, diversity and a random-label baseline at a fixed annotation budget; examine biased sampling and an independent test set.

topics.question: Why does a contextual bandit need to explore options that currently look worse?
topics.coverage: Trace actions, partial feedback, exploration cost and regret in a fictional recommendation task; distinguish one-step feedback from multi-step reinforcement learning.

topics.question: What does knowledge distillation transfer from a teacher model to a smaller student?
topics.coverage: Compare training targets, student capacity, matched-task outcomes and inherited errors; distinguish learning from teacher outputs from reducing the bit width of unchanged weights.

topics.question: How can a low-rank adapter change a model without updating every stored weight?
topics.coverage: Illustrate a weight update as a product of smaller matrices; separate trainable parameters, retained base weights and task evaluation from a tutorial or universal memory promise.

topics.question: Why can visually identical text have different character sequences in an AI dataset?
topics.coverage: Compare composed and combining-character forms, normalization and span offsets with a declared Unicode sample; inspect matching and annotation errors rather than infer meaning from byte equality.

topics.question: How can transliterated names prevent a document search from finding the right source?
topics.coverage: Compare native-script, Romanized and variant-spelling queries for a consented or fictional entity; distinguish entity resolution and retrieval recall from the quality of a generated translation.

topics.question: How can a tokenizer comparison separate morphological structure from the length of a written word?
topics.coverage: Use qualified annotations for a declared language pair with different word-formation patterns; inspect segmentation, length-normalized task errors and vocabulary coverage without ranking languages as intrinsically harder.

topics.question: What does a reranker decide after a document retriever has already selected candidates?
topics.coverage: Trace candidate generation, relevance scores, ordering and missing-candidate limits in a small controlled collection; evaluate retrieval recall separately from reranking precision and final answer support.

topics.question: What must an application retire when a model endpoint is withdrawn?
topics.coverage: Map versioned prompts, evaluation baselines, dependent tools, stored embeddings and fallback behavior in a hypothetical migration; separate replacing a service from disposing of physical hardware.

topics.question: How does abstaining change the relationship between model accuracy and the number of requests answered?
topics.coverage: Plot a risk-coverage tradeoff on labeled synthetic predictions as a declared threshold varies; include subgroup coverage and decision costs rather than equating fewer answers with a safer system.

001.parent: Applied AI, robotics and scientific systems
001.title: Longitudinal deployment and changing users

topics.question: How can an AI evaluation distinguish initial novelty from a lasting change in how people perform a task?
topics.coverage: Plan repeated baseline and follow-up observations, learning effects, participant attrition and task substitution in a hypothetical low-stakes deployment; distinguish a longitudinal outcome from a one-session productivity comparison.

topics.question: Why can a personalized assistant become less useful when a household or team changes?
topics.coverage: Trace shared versus individual preferences, consent to stored history, stale assumptions and re-evaluation after membership changes using fictional records; distinguish application memory governance from retraining model weights.
